main_text.p: rant. Hanc R. Abraham Zachuthus in Iuchasin ex Responsis Rabb Scherira Gaon egregie exponit, unde plura proferre constitueramus, sed quædam à Cl. L' Empereur in notis ad l. c. Benjaminis jam allata videmus, & alibi etiam ipsi prolixius de ea re agemus. Quare rem in compendium redegisse sufficiet.

VIII. In Academiis Babylonicis, Pumbeditha & Sora, erat ראש ישיבה Caput Academiæ, supremus ejus Rector & Professor. Hic solus in separata cathedra sedebat. Coram ipso, facie illi obversa, decem alii sedebant, quorum tres חברים Socii, vel Collegæ dicebantur: reliqui septem ראש הכלורת / quos Cl. L' Empereur reddit Capita communitatis. Post hos sex septemve (numerum certum eruere nunc non lubet, nec vacat;) aliæ classes Academicorum, quarum singulæ denos habebant. Atque hi omnes Rectoris illius partim discipuli erant, & partim etiam Assessores.

IX. Qui vero ראש הכלורת hic vocantur, Rectoris illius sunt hypodidascali, qui lectionem ab illo publicè explicatam cum discipulis repetunt, quæque his non sunt satis intellecta, uberius explicant & inculcant. Cod. Berach. fol. 57 1.f. הנכנס לאנם בחלום

נעשרה ראש ישיבה ליער נעשרה ראש לבני כלה רב פפא ורב הונא כריכה דרב יהושע חוו הלמא רב פפא דעייל לאנמא נעשרה ראש ישיבה רב הונא כריכה דרב יהושע דעייל ליער נעשרה ראש לבני כלה וגו' Qui sibi per quietem arundinetum ingredi videtur, fit Rector Academiæ: qui sylvam, hypodidascalus. R. Papa & R Houna, filius R. Iehosuæ, somnia habuerunt; R. Papa, qui arundinetum ingressus erat, fiebat Rector Scholæ; Rabb Houna autem, F. R. Iehosuæ, qui sylvam ingressus fuerat, ראש לבני כלה /

page.notes: The Hebrew lines are printed in a smaller, partly blurred type and some words are doubtful; the Hebrew reading of the lines beginning "נעשרה" and "ורב" may contain errors. The line "ראש לבני כלה /" at the end is a slash-marked catchword-like sign and may belong to the Hebrew text. The Hebrew of the Berachot quotation and the final words are transcribed as far as legible. The Latin of "Qui sibi per quietem" is in italic in the original.
